0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Orlando Magic host the Atlanta Hawks. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring), and Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Franz Wagner (shoulder soreness), Jase Richardson (back soreness) and Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain) are listed as day-to-day, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). The Magic lost all four meetings with the Hawks in the 2025-26 season, most recently 130-101 in Orlando on April 1, 2026.
